name: ewake
description: Ask Cursor about production: why an incident started, which team owns a service, what changed before it failed. Ewake answers from your service map, past investigations and deployments. The skills also report deployments and map the services of a repository.

EWAKE_HOST.title: Ewake host
EWAKE_HOST.description: Enter the host name of your Ewake dashboard, without https:// and without /mcp. Example: your-company.ewake.ai
